Narr... A cool breeze is blowing, and the weather is foggy all around. Inside a dense forest, daughters-in-law are picking greens from the fields.

Kusum21... Happy... Sister-in-law, this time our field has produced such wonderful cholai mustard spinach. And the fastest growing is this Bathua green... And the real fun of eating greens comes in the cold weather.

Narr... Saying this, Kusum, shivering in the cold, digs up the greens from the field bed and puts them in a basket. Meanwhile, Nupur uproots the spinach along with its roots.

Babita22... Getting a little serious... Nupur, what have you done? You uprooted the entire greens along with the roots. Hey, greens are not plucked like this; only the leaves are picked, and the stalk is left so that the greens can grow again.

Nupur19... Normal... Huhu Huuu Babita Bhabhi, I was just picking spinach leaves, and by mistake, I uprooted one of our plants.  The spinach plant was damaged.

Natr... Just then, Babita devised a solution and planted the spinach plant in the ground by digging the soil deep with a hoe. Due to the cold weather, the entire field was filled with fog. Champa and Madhavi were cooking food by setting up a stove a short distance away from the field when suddenly, an injured bull came roaring from the forest and came into their field and started growling at the three of them.

The bull growled, "Huuhu Huuu"

Nar... Seeing such a large bull in front of them, the three of them stood there in fear. Would these daughters-in-law be able to defend themselves? But the question is, why are these five daughters-in-law living in such a dense forest in such bitterly cold weather? To understand the root of the matter, let's start from the beginning.

Flashback
Nqrr... where old Dinesh is sitting on a cot, shivering in the cold.

Dinesh 50... Shivering, "Huuhu Huuh"  Huh... Hey brother, will anyone give me some tea today? I've been sitting on this cot for the last hour waiting for tea. Firstly, I couldn't sleep for a moment on this cot all night. And on top of that, I was given a blanket to cover myself with. It wasn't even cold, so I shivered in the cold all night... You all slept comfortably.

Nar... Seeing Dinesh fussing like this, Godavari sits on the thin bed on the floor, shivering from the cold.

Godavari45... angrily... yes, you should also try sleeping on the bed below one day. Hey, you've only been given a blanket to cover yourself. Among those sleeping below, two people get one blanket. Don't start blabbering every morning.

Dinesh50... trembling with anger... huh... Godavari, I beg you, I don't have a good temper with the cold anyway... Now, don't bother me this early in the morning. 

Nqr...Watching the mother-in-law and father-in-law bickering over morning tea, the five daughters-in-law were sitting in the open kitchen in the courtyard, where, due to the extreme cold today, there was a heavy fog and a cool breeze.

Madhavi 25...Shivering. Huh huh huh. This time, the cold weather in December is very bad. It used to be this cold only in January. And yet, we haven't made any preparations for the cold. We haven't bought any warm blankets, clothes, or anything.


Champa 24... (Normal) Huhuhu Madhavi Bhabhi, we'll think about preparing for the cold later. Right now, I have to make tea for Papa Ji, and the firewood is all gone. How will we light the stove without wood? If we had gone to the forest yesterday and collected firewood, we wouldn't be having so much trouble making tea and water.

Babita 22... (Normal) You're right, younger sister-in-law. In this cold weather, we can't manage without tea. For now, we'll have to figure out some way to light the stove.

Narrator... All five daughters-in-law start thinking of a way to light the stove, but there wasn't a single piece of wood available for fuel. Just then, Nupur sees the sack of chaff kept next to the stove.

Nupur 19... (Happily) Oh, I completely forgot that we have dry chaff! We can use that to light the fire and make tea.

Kusum 21... (Normal) Well, then what are we waiting for, sister-in-law? Quickly take the chaff out of the sack.

Narrator... As Nupur touched the sack of chaff, she found it cold and damp from being soaked in dew all night, and all the chaff inside was wet.

About CID:
----------
The first thrilling investigative series on Indian Television is also one of the most popular shows on Sony Entertainment Television. Dramatic and absolutely unpredictable, "C.I.D." has captivated viewers over the last twenty years and continues to keep audiences glued to their television sets with its thrilling plots and excitement. Also interwoven in its fast-paced plots are the personal challenges that the C.I.D. team faces with non-stop adventure, tremendous pressure and risk, all in the name of duty. The series consists of hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection and suspense. The protagonists of the serial are an elite group of officers belonging to the Crime Investigation Department, led by ACP Pradyuman (played by the dynamic Shivaji Satam). While the stories are plausible, there is an emphasis on dramatic plotting and technical complexities faced by the police. At every stage, the plot throws up intriguing twists and turns keeping the officers on the move as they track criminals, led by the smallest of clues.

भारतीय टेलीविजन पर पहली रोमांचक जांच श्रृंखला सोनी एंटरटेनमेंट टेलीविजन पर सबसे लोकप्रिय शो में से एक है। नाटकीय और बिल्कुल अप्रत्याशित, "सी.आई.डी." ने पिछले बीस वर्षों से दर्शकों को आकर्षित किया है और अपने रोमांचक कथानक और उत्साह के साथ दर्शकों को अपने टेलीविजन सेट से बांधे रखता है। इसके तेज़-तर्रार कथानक में व्यक्तिगत चुनौतियाँ भी शामिल हैं, जिनका सामना सी.आई.डी. टीम को बिना रुके रोमांच, जबरदस्त दबाव और जोखिम के साथ करना पड़ता है, यह सब कर्तव्य के नाम पर होता है। इस श्रृंखला में जांच, पता लगाने और रहस्य से जुड़ी हार्ड-कोर पुलिस प्रक्रियात्मक कहानियाँ शामिल हैं। धारावाहिक के नायक अपराध जांच विभाग से संबंधित अधिकारियों का एक कुलीन समूह है, जिसका नेतृत्व एसीपी प्रद्युमन (गतिशील शिवाजी साटम द्वारा निभाया गया) करता है। जबकि कहानियाँ विश्वसनीय हैं, नाटकीय कथानक और पुलिस द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली तकनीकी जटिलताओं पर ज़ोर दिया गया है। हर चरण में, कथानक में ऐसे दिलचस्प मोड़ आते हैं जो अधिकारियों को अपराधियों का पता लगाने के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं, जो सबसे छोटे सुरागों के आधार पर होते हैं

So keep walking, the next stop awaits.

👉 **What is Aloo Bedmi?**  
Aloo Bedmi is a traditional **North Indian breakfast**, especially popular in Uttar Pradesh and Delhi, made with a spicy potato curry served alongside deep-fried  puris (Bedmi Poori). But this recipe is special — it follows the **Aligarh-style**, where the flavors are bolder, spicier, and full of local touch.

✅ How to make  Bedmi dough  
✅ Tips to get crispy and puffed pooris

✅ A complete plate that’s perfect for festivals, weekends, or special occasions

📌 **Why You Should Try This Recipe:**
– Authentic Aligarh street food taste  
– No fancy ingredients – simple and easy to follow  
– Great for weekend breakfast or brunch  
– Loved by all age groups – kids to elders  
– 100% vegetarian and made with pantry staples

---

snippet.title: Delhi Election 2025: 20 रुपये की कंबल और 30 रुपए की खाट, दिल्ली में कैसे कटती है मजदूरों की रात?
snippet.description:
The capital city, Delhi, transforms into a major tourist destination during winter. People love the cold weather, but this comfort is only for those who have a home to stay in, food to eat, and warm clothes to wear. For the city's poor and homeless, however, these winter nights turn into a nightmare.
In this report, witness how the working-class struggles to get through the cold nights. Some rent a cot for ₹50 per night, while others have no choice but to sleep on the streets. Some seek shelter in night shelters, but due to poor conditions and hooliganism, they are often forced to return to the footpaths.
Watch this exclusive report by Shubham Vishwakarma from Khabargaon to uncover the harsh reality of Delhi’s cold nights…

----------------------------

देश की राजधानी दिल्ली सर्दियों के मौसम में एक खास पर्यटन स्थल बन जाती है। यहाँ की ठंडी जलवायु लोगों को बहुत पसंद आती है। लेकिन यह आनंद सिर्फ उन्हीं के लिए होता है जिनके पास रहने के लिए घर, खाने के लिए भोजन और पहनने के लिए गरम कपड़े होते हैं। वहीं, यही सर्दी दिल्ली के गरीब और बेघर लोगों के लिए एक डरावनी रात में बदल जाती है। हमारी इस रिपोर्ट में देखिए कि मजदूर वर्ग के लोग किस तरह अपनी रातें बिताने को मजबूर होते हैं। कुछ लोग हर रात 50 रुपये देकर खाट किराए पर लेते हैं, जबकि कुछ सड़क किनारे सोने के अलावा कोई दूसरा विकल्प नहीं पाते। कुछ लोग रैन बसेरों में शरण लेते हैं, लेकिन वहां की बदहाल स्थिति और गुंडागर्दी से परेशान होकर फिर से फुटपाथ पर लौटने को मजबूर हो जाते हैं।

खबरगांव के इस वीडियो में शुभम विश्वकर्मा की रिपोर्ट में देखिए दिल्ली की ठंडी रातों की काली सच्चाई...
